### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. It will transform how states analyze information, coordinate institutions, deliver services, and act on decisions.

2. We are certain: superintelligent AI will expand the capabilities of every government that gains access to it. Bureaucratic delay, fragmented knowledge, and limited human attention will no longer constrain what the state can accomplish.

3. Superintelligent AI will make governments faster, more coordinated, and more capable at every level. If it is built within the next 20 years, every government—from local councils to national administrations—will become more effective.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 107 words

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. It will give public institutions unprecedented capacity to analyze evidence, coordinate complex systems, deliver services, enforce laws, manage crises, and turn decisions into results. Bureaucratic delay, fragmented information, and limits on human attention will no longer define what governments can accomplish. From local councils to national administrations, superintelligence will strengthen planning, execution, and responsiveness across every function of the state. The consequences will vary with each government’s goals, but the institutional effect is certain: governments will become more capable, more coordinated, and more effective than ever before.
